  FROM reel_mark
), resolved AS (
  SELECT mark_kind, span_sec, MAX(CASE WHEN mark_kind = 'play' THEN score_id END) OVER (PARTITION BY reel_id, segment_no) AS active_score

)

  "decision-recover-signatures-from-conjugate-leaves": "WITH ranked AS (

  FROM rubbed_leaf AS t
  LEFT JOIN inspection_slip AS s ON s.copy_code = t.copy_code
    AND s.gathering_no = t.gathering_no
    AND s.leaf_pos = t.leaf_count + 1 - t.leaf_pos
    AND s.intact = 1 AND s.signature IS NOT NULL
)

FROM ranked

  "decision-refill-meter-csv": "WITH readings AS (
  SELECT tick_no, product_tag, dial_litres, LAG(dial_litres) OVER (ORDER BY tick_no) AS previous_dial
  FROM refill_tick

  SELECT tick_no, tick_no || ',"' || REPLACE(product_tag, '"', '""') || '",' || ((dial_litres - previous_dial + 100) % 100) || CHAR(10) AS record
  FROM readings
  WHERE dial_litres IS NOT NULL AND previous_dial IS NOT NULL
)

  "decision-regional-capacity-commitment-under-cash-cap": "WITH priced AS (
  SELECT o.region_code, o.offer_code, o.fee_cents, o.fee_cents + MAX(0, f.demand_units - o.included_units) * f.overage_cents AS period_cents
  FROM capacity_offer AS o
  JOIN region_forecast AS f ON f.region_code = o.region_code
)
SELECT e.offer_code AS east_offer, w.offer_code AS west_offer, e.fee_cents + w.fee_cents AS upfront_cents, e.period_cents + w.period_cents AS total_cents
FROM priced AS e CROSS JOIN priced AS w
WHERE e.region_code = 'East' AND w.region_code = 'West' AND e.fee_cents + w.fee_cents <= 100

), resolved AS (
  SELECT mark_kind, span_sec, MAX(CASE WHEN mark_kind = 'play' THEN score_id END) OVER (PARTITION BY reel_id, segment_no) AS active_score

SELECT active_score AS score_id, SUM(span_sec) AS performed_sec, COUNT(*) AS cue_count

  FROM rubbed_leaf AS t
  LEFT JOIN inspection_slip AS s ON s.copy_code = t.copy_code

  FROM capacity_offer AS o
  JOIN region_forecast AS f ON f.region_code = o.region_code
)
SELECT e.offer_code AS east_offer, w.offer_code AS west_offer, e.fee_cents + w.fee_cents AS upfront_cents, e.period_cents + w.period_cents AS total_cents
